subject: MAP: ClearProof acceptance ledger & cutover timeline
messages:
From: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@mediworks.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@mediworks.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation planning for Redwood MAP

Markus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. MediWorks is aligned on running a 4-week evaluation but we want a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that specifies concrete acceptance tests so our legal and security teams can scope the pilot sign-off. High level asks from our side:

- Clear pass/fail criteria for precision and latency on our clinical summarization flow
- List of required data samples (redacted) and format for test vectors
- Exit gates (what constitutes a failed pilot vs. needs follow-up)
- Timeline to reach an internal purchase decision once acceptance is met

I've attached a short trial-scope.pdf that summarizes our constraints. Can you share a MAP spreadsheet with acceptance tests and responsibilities? Ideally we want to lock acceptance criteria by next Friday so procurement can start paperwork.

Best,
Sana Kapoor
Head of Clinical Ops — MediWorks

Attachment: trial-scope.pdf (PDF stub)

From: markus.klein@redwood.com <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@mediworks.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation planning for Redwood MAP

Sana —

Thanks for the clear brief and the scope doc. Attached is a first draft MAP (MAP-ClearProof-v1.xlsx) that breaks the evaluation into 3 evidence lanes: Quality, Performance, and Ops/Compliance. Key items I called out in the spreadsheet:

- Quality lane: 25 representative redacted notes (you can replace these with CSV test vectors) with target F1 >= 0.86 on named entity concordance and end-to-end extractive summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.62.
- Performance lane: 95th percentile latency <= 420ms for 512-token runs under a 5 RPS sustained load.
- Ops/Compliance lane: logs accessible via secure S3 path; SOC2 evidence checklist items 1–6 must be verified.

Exit gates (short):
- Hard fail: failure to reach quality targets on the defined test vectors after two remediation cycles OR unresolved security control gaps flagged by your audit team.
- Soft fail / remediation: quality within 5–8% of target; we'll propose remediation changes (prompting, quantization profile adjustments) and run a focused 1-week re-test.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Tue (2026-09-22): confirm test vectors and sampling owner from MediWorks
- Fri (2026-09-26): sign-off on MAP (criteria + owners) 
- Mon 2026-09-29 to Fri 2026-10-24: evaluation window (4 weeks)
- Mon 2026-10-27: acceptance review & procurement decision deadline

Camila, Jordan — added you for ownership on technical testcases and rollout plan. Sana, let me know whether the targets above look reasonable; happy to iterate and tighten metrics if needed.

Next steps: I also posted the MAP draft to a shared Drive (link below) and created HubSpot deal tasks under DEAL-9231. If you want, we can run a quick 30m call Thursday to finalize owners.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-ClearProof-v1.xlsx (Excel stub)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqClearProofMAP
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9231

From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@mediworks.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: ClearProof acceptance ledger & cutover timeline

Sana / team —

Quick technical notes and acceptance-test shapes so the MAP can be implemented by your engineers without ambiguity:

1) Test vectors: please provide 25 redacted clinical notes as CSV with columns: id, patient_age_range, encounter_type, raw_text, expected_summary. If PHI remains in the sample we recommend AES-encrypted upload to our secure endpoint (we can provide a key).

2) Deterministic evaluation harness: we'll run 3 seeded runs per vector to capture variance. Primary metric for pass = averaged ROUGE-L on expected_summary. Secondary checks: hallucination rate (tokens flagged against a negation detector) and entity drop rate.

3) Performance harness: we'll use the Redwood load runner with a warmup of 200 requests, then 5 minute sustained windows at 1, 3, and 5 RPS. Please confirm whether any of your samples have >1024 tokens; longer sequences will use the 1024 path and have a separate latency SLO.

4) Ops/Observability: we will provide a temporary S3 bucket and CloudTrail logs; Jordan will coordinate the bucket ACLs. Also note our KV-prefix caching will require a stable conversation ID; best to include a request_id column in your CSV.

I'll attach eval-test-vectors.csv as a blank template. Happy to hop on a call to walk through specifics.

—Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: eval-test-vectors.csv (CSV template)

From: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@mediworks.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@mediworks.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: ClearProof acceptance ledger & cutover timeline

Markus / Camila —

This looks good and aligns with our internal risk appetite. A couple of small asks from procurement/security:

- Can Redwood include a short acceptance rubric text we can paste into the PO that references the exact metric thresholds and the remediation flow? Procurement prefers crisp language.
- For the SOC2 evidence we will need a point contact and a timeline for delivering the items; can Jordan commit to a 3-business-day turnaround on initial items once we request them?

If you can update the MAP with those two items I can route it internally. We confirm the samples will be sent by end of day Wednesday (2026-09-24). We also prefer the acceptance review meeting be 60 minutes on Mon 2026-10-27.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Sana
Head of Clinical Ops — MediWorks

From: markus.klein@redwood.com <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@mediworks.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-24T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: ClearProof acceptance ledger & cutover timeline

Sana —

Will do. I'll update the MAP this afternoon to include: (a) PO-ready acceptance rubric language; (b) Jordan as SOC2 evidence owner with a 3-business-day SLA for initial requests; and (c) an explicit remediation cadence (one remediation cycle + one re-test window).

I also added a HubSpot task and calendar hold for the acceptance review on 2026-10-27 10:00–11:00 PT (invite sent). Once you upload the test vectors to the shared Drive link I'll coordinate the secure upload details for any encrypted files.

If anything changes on your side, flag it in the thread — otherwise we'll aim to finalize the MAP by Friday (2026-09-26).

Cheers,
Markus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9231
Attachments updated: MAP-ClearProof-v1.xlsx
